adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6#saveChanges` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, which would issue a PUT to `/admin/customize/embedding` via the new `admin/adapters/embedding.js.es6`. The corresponding `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` (new file) does not persist anything and simply re-renders the serializer. However, the provided `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` does not include any save button or UI wiring that triggers `saveChanges`, and the only editable state in the template is per-host CRUD handled by `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`. So this is a real mismatch/likely dead or misleading API/action, but the claimed user-visible "false confirmation" isn’t directly verifiable from the diff.
